# U — Hosted checkout and order confirmation

**Specs:** `checkout` (all 3 scenarios), `checkout-page` (all 2 scenarios), `order-confirmation-page` (all 3 scenarios); consumes (does not rebuild) `term-phased-price-schedule` (schedule shown before signing and stored on the order), `broadband-facts-label` (label shown in review and snapshotted), `device-acquisition-mode` (financing decision at "Continue to payment"), `eligibility-gated-offer` (serviceability re-check)
**Depends on:** E, L, M, Q, R, S, T · **Unblocks:** generated by verify-plan · **Decisions:** D-005, D-020, D-021, D-023, D-031, D-035, D-041, D-042, D-043, D-044, D-050, D-059
**Owner prerequisites:** OA-05 (Checkout application + Adyen test connector; **Payment Only application, D-061; see "Gate", below**) · **Skill refs:** `commercetools-checkout` (`references/payment-only-mode.md`: session creation, `paymentFlow`/`checkoutFlow`, messages), `commercetools-storefront` (cart, shipping, order creation), grocery precedent `../b2c-grocery/plan/workstreams/V-hosted-checkout.md` and `../b2c-grocery/site/lib/ct/checkout-session.ts`, `app/api/checkout/session/route.ts`, `components/checkout/CheckoutFlow.tsx`

## Goal
A guest or signed-in customer walks through contact details, service address (with a serviceability check), delivery, and a review that shows the price schedule and Broadband Facts labels, then pays in the hosted Checkout (Adyen test mode) mounted inside our page; the order is created by the hosted Checkout, finalized with our custom fields, and `/order-confirmation/[orderNumber]` shows the order's real reference and state. The checkout steps, confirmation and order states are not drawn: Junior design choice (D-068); screenshots taken by Claude, owner may comment.

Facts the whole workstream depends on, read from files, not from memory:
1. `plan/PROJECT-FINDINGS.md` must contain L's section "checkout spike (L-08)" with: (a) **application type** the spike used (must be Payment Only, D-061) and its key, (b) the exact Cart update action that set `recurringPaymentConfiguration` with `paymentStrategy: Checkout` (docs: [Recurring Orders in Checkout](https://docs.commercetools.com/checkout/recurring-orders-in-checkout), actions `setRecurringPaymentStrategy` / `setRecurringPaymentConfiguration`), (c) the Sessions request body that worked, (d) whether `metadata.futureOrderNumber` was accepted, (e) the registered `paymentReturnUrl`. 
2. `plan/TODO-MANUAL-TESTING.md` row OA-05 must be `DONE` (Gate 4) and Gate 2 (L-08) must be recorded as passed.
3. If any item is missing or L-08 failed: write `Q-U-01` in `plan/QUESTIONS.md` (blocking: yes) quoting what is missing and **stop**; do not "try it anyway".

**Checkout mode (D-061, confirmed by the owner 2026-10-07):** the hosted Checkout runs in **Payment Only** mode; our own steps own contact, address and delivery, and the hosted Checkout is used only for payment and order creation ([docs](https://docs.commercetools.com/checkout/overview#payment-only-mode)). This refines D-041 ("Complete flow"); OA-05 creates a Payment Only application. `lib/config/checkout.ts` exports `CHECKOUT_FLOW: 'payment' | 'checkout' = 'payment'`; the env/config switch stays (`'checkout'` would run `checkoutFlow` after our steps), but the delivered default and everything tested is `'payment'`. U-01 verifies that the application key in `CTP_CHECKOUT_APP_KEY` is of type `Payment Only` and records it.

## Design

### 1. Pre-checkout steps on `/[locale]/bundle/checkout` (D-050)
One page, five steps, step in the URL `?step=contact|address|delivery|review|payment` (default `contact`; visiting a later step whose predecessors are incomplete redirects to the first incomplete one). **All state lives on the commercetools cart** (server) — the client holds only form drafts. Digital-only bundles (no physical line) skip `delivery` (D-043); the stepper then shows 4 steps. A line is physical iff `isPhysicalLine(line)` (`lib/checkout/physical.ts`): `line.kind === 'equipment' || line.kind === 'device'` (M's mapped cart line carries the offer `kind` from H's `OfferKind`; if M named it differently, change this one function).

Page `app/[locale]/bundle/checkout/page.tsx` (Server Component): no session cart or empty cart → `redirect('/bundle')` (outside any try/catch); renders title strip "Home / My bundle / Checkout", H1 "Checkout", and `<CheckoutWizard/>` (client) next to the sticky 320 px `CheckoutSummary` (same visual language as `design/specs/cart.md` "Order summary"; sticky `top: 96px`; under 768 px the summary moves **above** the steps as a collapsed `<details>` "Order summary · {total}"). `Cache-Control: private, no-store` for `/:locale/bundle/checkout` and `/:locale/order-confirmation/:path*` via `next.config.ts` `headers()` (append; test in `next.config.test.ts`).

| Step | Content | Server effect (route) | Continue enabled when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 Contact | Email, Mobile phone (optional). Signed in: email read-only (from session customer), phone prefilled from default service address. Guest (D-035): text "Have an account? **Sign in**" → `/login?redirect=/bundle/checkout`; sign-in merges the anonymous cart (R/E) so the step reopens with the same bundle | `POST /api/checkout/details` `{ email, phone? }` → `setCustomerEmail` | valid email (`^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$`, ≤ 254) |
| 2 Service address | Signed in with saved addresses: radio cards of T's `useAddresses()` where `address.isService && address.country === market.country`; **preselect only `pickPreselected(addresses)`** (T) — none selected when no default; "Use a different address" shows the form. Form fields = T's `AddressInput` + `validateAddress` (T); checkbox "Billing address is the same" (default on) else a second form. After Continue the result of the **serviceability check (K)** is shown | `POST /api/checkout/details` `{ serviceAddress, billingAddress? }` → `setShippingAddress`, `setBillingAddress`; server re-reads the cart (totals/tax recalculated by the platform) and runs K's check for **every service line in the cart** at `serviceAddress.postalCode` | address valid **and** check returned no unservable line |
| 3 Delivery (physical only) | Radio list of methods from `GET /api/checkout/delivery` (name, price, e.g. "Standard shipping · $0.00" — render the price returned, never assume free, seed spec "Modeling notes"); one method preselected = first returned | `POST /api/checkout/delivery` `{ shippingMethodId }` → `setShippingMethod` | a method selected |
| 4 Review | `ReviewStep`: lines grouped Plans / Devices / Add-ons & equipment; per plan the **price schedule** (M's `PriceSchedule`: every period, total contract value, end-of-term price) and its **Broadband Facts label** (M's `BroadbandLabel`); per device line L/Q's acquisition summary + end-of-term notice (Q `AcquisitionLine`/`EndOfTermNotice`); service start date ("Your service starts {date}" from `computeServiceStart`); address blocks with "Change" links; totals from the cart; checkbox "I have read the {price schedule} and the {Broadband Facts label(s)} and agree to the {terms}" (links to `/legal/terms`, W; **required**, UI only) | `GET /api/checkout/review` → `CheckoutReview` (below) | checkbox ticked |
| 5 Payment | Button on step 4 is **"Continue to payment"**; it calls `POST /api/checkout/session` (financing decision, guards, session) and only on success shows step 5: the hosted payment mounted in `<div data-ctc />` | `POST /api/checkout/session` | — |

**The summary and every price on every step is a projection of the last cart response** (spec `checkout-page` "Modeling notes"): `CheckoutSummary` receives the `Cart` returned by the previous call (`details`, `delivery`, `review` all return the full mapped cart) and never computes totals. Rows: Plans, Add-ons, Equipment & devices, Shipping, Tax, **Due today** (= `cart.totalPrice`; the first order contains the first recurring period, Q §4), "Monthly after today" (L's schedule `monthlyAfterToday`) and for multi-period offers "Total over the term" (L's `contractTotal`). Tax is the D-044 placeholder 0%: it shows `$0.00`, never hidden.

```ts
// lib/types.ts, section "// ===== U: checkout =====" (append)
export type CheckoutStep = 'contact' | 'address' | 'delivery' | 'review' | 'payment';
export interface ShippingOption { id: string; key: string; name: string; description?: string; price: Money }
export interface CheckoutReview {
  cart: Cart;
  serviceStartDate: string;                     // 'YYYY-MM-DD' (see §5)
  schedules: Array<{ lineId: string; record: unknown /* L's schedule record, opaque to U */ }>;
  labels: Array<{ lineId: string; label: BroadbandLabelData /* M's label type */ }>;
  monthlyAfterToday: Money; contractTotal: Money | null; dueToday: Money;
  needsDelivery: boolean;
}
```
Open question "multiple delivery addresses" → **single address only** (cart `shippingMode: Single`, D-005/D-059). Open question "net terms / credit line available?" → **not offered** (D-005): payment is card via hosted Checkout only.

### 2. Routes (all `private, no-store`; errors `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`, E's `ApiError`; success returns the full mapped `Cart` unless noted; 400 `NO_CART` when the session has no cart; the cart is always **re-read after each write**)
| Route | Body | Result / errors |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST /api/checkout/details` | `{ email?: string; phone?: string; serviceAddress?: AddressInput; billingAddress?: AddressInput }` (at least one key) | `{ cart, serviceability?: { ok: true } }`. 400 `INVALID_EMAIL` / `INVALID_ADDRESS {fields}` (T's `validateAddress`); 422 `COUNTRY_MISMATCH` (address country ≠ market country); **422 `NOT_SERVICEABLE {lineIds, postalCode}`** (address **is stored**, so the buyer sees the cart repriced/flagged; the step shows the K message and offers "Change address" and "Edit My bundle") |
| `GET /api/checkout/delivery` | — | `{ options: ShippingOption[], needsDelivery: boolean, cart }` — `needsDelivery=false` for digital-only (server also sets `malva-delivery-digital` once). Options from `GET /shipping-methods/matching-cart?cartId=…` (SDK `shippingMethods().matchingCart().get({queryArgs:{cartId}})`), never filtered client-side. Empty → `options: []` (UI: "no delivery method" state, below) |
| `POST /api/checkout/delivery` | `{ shippingMethodId }` | `{ cart }`; 422 `SHIPPING_METHOD_NOT_AVAILABLE` if the id is not in the matching list (checked against the matching list **before** `setShippingMethod`) |
| `GET /api/checkout/review` | — | `CheckoutReview`; also used by the window-focus total check (§6) |
| `POST /api/checkout/session` | `{ expectedTotalCents: number }` | see §3 |
| `POST /api/checkout/complete` | `{ orderId: string }` | see §4 |

Cart writes use M's `updateCart(cartId, actions)` (version-conflict retry) and `getOrCreateCart(session)` from `lib/ct/cart.ts` (the same names Q uses; if M names them otherwise use M's). Actions: `setCustomerEmail {email}`, `setShippingAddress {address}`, `setBillingAddress {address}`, `setShippingMethod {shippingMethod:{typeId:'shipping-method', id}}` ([docs](https://docs.commercetools.com/learning-implement-checkout/custom-checkout/shipping)). Address mapping: `streetName` → `streetName`, `additionalStreetInfo`, `state`, `postalCode`, `country`, `phone` → `phone`, `firstName`, `lastName`, plus `email` on the shipping address. For signed-in customers with a saved address chosen, the same `AddressInput` is sent (no id).

**No delivery method for address** (`checkout-page` scenario): when `options` is empty the step shows a bordered notice "We can't deliver equipment to this address with any delivery method." + "What you can change: use a different service address, or remove the equipment and devices from My bundle." with links; **Continue stays disabled**. Dev-only switch `DEV_FORCE_NO_DELIVERY=true` (honoured only when `NODE_ENV === 'development'`) makes the delivery route return `options: []` so Claude can check the state.
**Address change moves tax** (`checkout-page`): after step 2's write the summary shows `taxedPrice`/`shippingInfo` from the response; delivery options are re-fetched when entering step 3 (a method selected before the address change is cleared by the platform when it no longer matches; the step reselects the first returned option).

### 3. `POST /api/checkout/session` (`[SKILL: commercetools-checkout]`)
Checks run **in this order**; the first failure answers and **no session is created**:
1. session cart missing → 400 `NO_CART`; empty → 400 `EMPTY_CART`; cart `cartState !== 'Active'` → 409 `ALREADY_ORDERED { orderNumber }` when `session.pendingOrderNumber` exists and that order exists, else 409 `CART_NOT_ACTIVE`.
2. body `expectedTotalCents` not a safe integer → 400 `INVALID_BODY`.
3. `cart.customerEmail` missing → 422 `NO_CONTACT`; `shippingAddress` missing → 422 `NO_ADDRESS`; physical lines and no `shippingInfo` → 422 `NO_DELIVERY`.
4. **Revalidate rules server-side (never trust the client):** K's serviceability for the cart lines at the stored postal code → 422 `NOT_SERVICEABLE`; K's eligibility/exclusivity re-check (spec `eligibility-gated-offer` "Eligibility lost before checkout") → 422 `ELIGIBILITY_LOST {lineIds, reasons}`; Q's `assertDeviceCartIntegrity(cart)` → 422 `DEVICE_PRICE_INVALID` (the silent price-fallback trap); H/L price-mode check is implicit in Q/M writes.
5. **Recalculate** the cart (`recalculate` action, `updateProductData: false`) and compare `cart.totalPrice.centAmount` with `expectedTotalCents` → 409 `TOTAL_CHANGED { total: Money }` (spec `checkout` "Totals moved after authorization", D-042).
6. **Financing decision (Q §5):** if any line has `acquisitionMode ≠ outright`, call the server function behind `POST /api/devices/financing/decision` (exported from `lib/ct/devices.ts`, Q-07) with the cart: `declined` → 422 `FINANCING_DECLINED { reason }`; `sign-in-required` → 401 `SIGN_IN_REQUIRED` (client redirects to `/login?redirect=/bundle/checkout?step=review`); `approved` → `recordFinancingDecision(cartId, decision)`.
7. **Recurring cart:** if any line has `recurrenceInfo`, `ensureRecurringPaymentStrategy(cartId)` sends `{ action: 'setRecurringPaymentStrategy', paymentStrategy: 'Checkout' }` (**copy the exact shape L-08 recorded**; Cart OpenAPI in the knowledge tool does not yet list it, so this one action is typed with a narrow cast inside that function) unless `cart.recurringPaymentConfiguration?.paymentStrategy === 'Checkout'` already. Docs: Checkout requires it ([docs](https://docs.commercetools.com/checkout/recurring-orders-in-checkout)); allocations stay empty, Checkout's Recurring Payment Job sets 100 % to the stored method after the first payment.
8. **Order number (idempotency):** `orderNumber = session.pendingOrderNumber` when `session.pendingCartId === cart.id`, else `generateOrderNumber()` (`MLV-` + 8 chars of Crockford base32 without `I L O U`, `crypto.randomInt`; regex `^MLV-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{8}$`; ~40 bits so the confirmation URL is not guessable) and store `pendingOrderNumber`, `pendingCartId`, `pendingTotalCents` in the session cookie (fields appended to E's `Session` type in `lib/ct/session.ts`; U adds them with a test). A second click, a second tab, or a retry after failure therefore reuses the **same** `futureOrderNumber`: commercetools refuses a duplicate order number, so **no duplicate order can be created** (spec "Placement fails at the last moment").
9. Create the session: token `POST {CTP_AUTH_URL}/oauth/token` with `grant_type=client_credentials&scope=manage_sessions:{projectKey}` (Basic auth; same as grocery `getSessionsToken`, **this file is the only raw `fetch` to commercetools**; lint exception comment), then `POST https://session.{region}.commercetools.com/{projectKey}/sessions` body
```json
{ "cart": { "cartRef": { "id": "<cartId>" } },
  "metadata": { "applicationKey": "<CTP_CHECKOUT_APP_KEY>", "futureOrderNumber": "MLV-7K3F9QXD" } }
```
([docs](https://docs.commercetools.com/checkout/installing-checkout#create-checkout-sessions)); region from `getRegion(CTP_API_URL)` (E). Response → `{ sessionId, projectKey, region, orderNumber, flow: CHECKOUT_FLOW, expiresAt }` (`expiryAt` of the session response). Errors: `CheckoutSessionError` `TOKEN_FAILED | SESSION_FAILED` → 502 `CHECKOUT_UNAVAILABLE` (message never contains the token or a body). Duplicate-order-number rejection from the Sessions API (`400` with `DuplicateField` on `orderNumber`) → look the order up: found → 409 `ALREADY_ORDERED { orderNumber }`, not found → 502.
Session expiry: the SDK session expires (about an hour); the payment step is created **as late as possible** (only when the buyer presses "Continue to payment") and on `expired_session` the step offers "Start payment again" (new session, same order number).

### 4. Mounting the hosted Checkout and finishing (`components/checkout/PaymentStep.tsx`, client)
`import('@commercetools/checkout-browser-sdk')` dynamically; `const start = flow === 'payment' ? paymentFlow : checkoutFlow;` options `{ projectKey, region, sessionId, locale: sdkLocale(locale), styles: checkoutStyles(), onInfo, onWarn, onError }` (+ `skipPaymentSuccessPage: true, skipPaymentErrorPage: true` only for `checkoutFlow`; these keys apply only to `checkoutFlow`, [docs](https://docs.commercetools.com/checkout/browser-sdk#configuration-properties)). Render `<div data-ctc />` (inline mount; without it the widget goes full page). `sdkLocale(locale)`: `de-*` → `de`, else `en-US` (the SDK knows `en-US` and `de`, not `de-DE`; copied from the grocery finding). `lib/checkout/styles.ts` maps tokens to the SDK CSS variables (`--color-primary` ← `--color-action` `#8745ae`-class token value read via `getComputedStyle`, `--font-family` ← Roboto stack, `--border-radius` ← `--radius-pill`; list the variables the docs [custom-style page](https://docs.commercetools.com/checkout/custom-style) allow, use only those).
Events — `lib/checkout/events.ts` (pure, client-safe) `parseCheckoutMessage(message: unknown): CheckoutEvent` where
```ts
export type CheckoutEvent =
  | { type: 'order-created'; orderId: string }          // code 'checkout_completed' or 'order_created', payload.order.id (string)
  | { type: 'cancelled' }                                // 'checkout_cancelled'
  | { type: 'payment-failed' }                           // 'payment_failed'
  | { type: 'session-expired' }                          // 'expired_session'
  | { type: 'not-orderable' }                            // 'non_orderable_cart_error'
  | { type: 'cart-gone' }                                // 'cart_not_found' | 'cart_emptied_during_checkout' | 'cart_empty'
  | { type: 'other' };
```
(Message shape from the docs: `{ severity, code, message, payload: { order: { id } }, correlationId }`; both completion codes arrive, hand the order over **once**.) Tests use payloads copied from the docs.
- `order-created` → `POST /api/checkout/complete { orderId }` → on `{ orderNumber }` `router.replace('/order-confirmation/' + orderNumber)`; if `complete` fails the step shows "Your payment went through. We're finishing your order." + button "Try again" (calls complete again, idempotent) and, after 3 failures, a link to `/order-confirmation/<pendingOrderNumber>` (the page can finalize lazily, §5).
- `payment-failed` → banner "Your payment didn't go through. Try again or use another card." (widget stays; the hosted component has its own retry); no navigation, **no order**, bundle intact.
- `cancelled` → back to step 4 with notice "Payment was cancelled. Your bundle is unchanged."
- `session-expired` → notice "Your payment session expired." + button "Start payment again".
- `not-orderable` (**Placement fails at the last moment**) → `PlacementFailedPanel`: "We couldn't place your order. Something changed in your bundle (a price, discount or availability). Nothing was charged for an order that wasn't placed." + buttons "Review my order" (re-runs `GET /api/checkout/review`, shows the new total, then a fresh "Continue to payment") and "Back to My bundle". The retry reuses the same order number (§3.8) so it cannot duplicate.
- `cart-gone` → `router.replace('/bundle')`.
**Re-authorization on total change (D-042):** the payment step stores `baselineTotalCents` (the `expectedTotalCents` sent). While step 5 is open, on `visibilitychange` (tab becomes visible) and every 60 s the client calls `GET /api/checkout/review`; if `cart.totalPrice.centAmount !== baselineTotalCents` the widget is unmounted (removed `data-ctc` content; the Checkout session is simply abandoned and the connector cancels any open authorization) and `TotalChangedNotice` appears: "The total changed from {old} to {new}. Review your order and pay again." with one button "Review again" → step 4 with the new numbers; "Continue to payment" then creates a **new session** (fresh authorization for the new amount). The server enforces the same rule in §3.5, so a stale client cannot start a session for a stale total.
The page's own `POST /api/checkout/complete` (`lib/ct/checkout.ts` `completeCheckout`): loads the order by id (`orders().withId`), verifies `order.cart.id === session.pendingCartId` (else 403 `FORBIDDEN`), **finalizes** it (§5), sets `session.lastOrderNumber = order.orderNumber`, removes `cartId`, `pendingOrderNumber`, `pendingCartId`, `pendingTotalCents` from the session cookie, answers `{ orderNumber }`. Idempotent: if the session no longer has `pendingCartId` and `lastOrderNumber` equals the order's number → `{ orderNumber }` without work. The client then `mutate(KEY_CART, null, false)` (M's cart key) and `mutate(KEY_ORDERS)` (S) before navigating.

### 5. Order custom fields: mechanism and contents (decision)
Question: write custom fields to the **cart** (copied to the order) or to the **order afterwards**? Verified in the Types docs: resource type id `order` is shared by Cart and Order and "when a Cart is ordered, the CustomFields need to be copied to the Order" ([docs](https://docs.commercetools.com/api/projects/types#resourcetypeid)); but **a Cart or Order has exactly one Type**, and the cart already carries `malva-cart` (postal code and serviceability flags, ARCHITECTURE) while the order must be `malva-order` (serviceStartDate, priceSchedule, labelSnapshot, cancellation, returnRequest). Copying would therefore produce an order of the wrong type. **Decision: finalize the order after creation** with one update `setCustomType` (type key `malva-order`, with `fields`), implemented as:
```ts
// lib/checkout/finalize.ts (pure, no I/O)
export interface FinalizeInput { order: MappedOrderForFinalize; now: Date; schedule: string; labels: string }
export function buildFinalizeUpdate(input: FinalizeInput): { actions: OrderUpdateAction[] } // [] when already finalized
```
`actions = [{ action: 'setCustomType', type: { typeId: 'type', key: 'malva-order' }, fields: { serviceStartDate, priceSchedule, labelSnapshot } }]`, returned `[]` when `order.custom.fields.serviceStartDate` already exists (idempotent). Field contents (all String custom fields; G defines `malva-order`; **if G's field names or types differ, G's file wins**, U-05 first reads `scripts/seed/data/` and aligns):
- `serviceStartDate` = `computeServiceStart(order.lineItems, order.createdAt)` → ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC calendar date). Rule (D-023): per **service line** (an internet or phone plan; offers of kind `base-package`) the start = order date + lead days (`INSTALL_LEAD_DAYS = { cable: 5, 'fixed-wireless': 0, mobile: 0 }`, key = the plan's `technology` fact, `lib/config/checkout.ts`); the order-level value is the **earliest** start among service lines (Planner default: conservative for V's cancel window: once any service line has started the whole order is no longer cancellable online); no service line (devices/equipment/add-ons only) → the order date.
- `priceSchedule` = `JSON.stringify` of L's schedule record for the order's service lines, built from the **order's recorded line prices** (exactly L's serializer; U never reshapes it). Spec "Schedule fixed at commitment": later catalog changes do not touch it.
- `labelSnapshot` = `JSON.stringify({ [lineItemId]: label })` produced by M's label builder for each plan line from the order's line + offer facts at finalize time (seconds after payment). Pitfall accepted: facts changed in those seconds would be snapshotted; recorded in `IDEAS.md`.
Server function `finalizeOrder(orderId)` in `lib/ct/checkout.ts` (reads the order, builds inputs, applies `buildFinalizeUpdate` with one 409 retry) is called from (1) `POST /api/checkout/complete`, (2) lazily by the confirmation page when `serviceStartDate` is missing (the buyer closed the tab before `complete` ran) — so a paid order is never left without the fields, and (3) `scripts/demo/place-test-order.ts`. It never throws to the page: failure is logged (`console.error('finalizeOrder failed', code)`) and the page renders without the snapshot sections.
Cart custom fields we **do** rely on being copied: line-item fields (type `malva-line-item`, resource `line-item`): `offerKey`, `acquisitionMode`, `acquisitionTermMonths`, `parentLineItemId` stay on the order lines automatically (this is Q's "Mode persisted to the order").

### 6. Confirmation page `/[locale]/order-confirmation/[orderNumber]` (D-031: no email; D-035 guests)
Server Component, **renders from the stored order** (`getOrderForConfirmation(orderNumber)`: `orders().withOrderNumber({ orderNumber })` + S's order mapper; never the cart, never the session's cart) so reload, bookmark and forwarded link work. `orderNumber` is validated with the regex above first (else `notFound()`); the reserved value `return` is the hosted Checkout's **return URL**: the Application's `paymentReturnUrl` is one fixed URL per connector (docs: only one; it receives `?orderId=` or `?orderNumber=`); register `…/order-confirmation/return` (owner prerequisite, reported) and in the page: `if (orderNumber === 'return') { resolve order by searchParams.orderNumber ?? orderId; redirect('/order-confirmation/' + number) }` (locale taken from the market cookie via the locale-aware `redirect` from `@/i18n/routing`).
Access (Planner default): full view when the signed-in customer owns the order (`order.customerId === session.customerId`) **or** `session.lastOrderNumber === orderNumber`; otherwise a **limited view** (reference, state, line names, totals; **no** address, email, phone, payment info) because the number is the capability link a guest bookmarks; unknown number → `notFound()`.
Content (design not drawn: Junior design choice, D-068; uses tokens only): title strip "Home / Order confirmation"; banner (`pink-50`, `--radius-xl`) per **true state**:
| `order.orderState` | Banner / tag | Sentence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Open` | "Order placed." tag **Order placed** | "Your order number is {orderNumber}. We've received your order and your payment." |
| `Confirmed` | "Order confirmed." tag **Confirmed** | "Your order is confirmed and being set up." |
| `Complete` | "Order complete." tag **Complete** | "Everything on this order has been delivered." |
| `Cancelled` | no success banner; `--color-danger` tag **Cancelled** | "This order was cancelled." (+ V's cancellation details on the order detail page) |
`paymentState` (commercetools enum `BalanceDue | Failed | Pending | CreditOwed | Paid`) is shown as small text mapped `Paid`→"Payment: paid", `Pending`→"Payment: pending", `BalanceDue`→"Payment: balance due", `Failed`→"Payment: failed"; `CreditOwed` and absent → hidden (message keys `confirmation.payment.*`). Sections: **Order summary** (lines with quantity, acquisition mode/term for devices, recurring and one-time prices; shipping, tax, **Due today**, "Monthly after today", total over the term) all from the order's recorded prices; **Service** ("Service start {date}", service address); **Price schedule** (from `custom.fields.priceSchedule`, same `PriceSchedule` component) and **labels** link "View Broadband Facts label" (opens the order detail page, S/V); **What happens next** list: "Your service starts on {date}." / (physical) "Your equipment ships separately. Tracking appears on your order page once it ships." / "Need to change your mind? You can cancel until {date}." (shown for signed-in owners only while `Date.now() < serviceStartDate` at 00:00 UTC, using U's own comparison — U never imports V — with a link to the order detail page) / "Questions? Contact support" (link `/support`).
Actions: **Print receipt** (`window.print()`; `@media print` hides header, footer, buttons; Planner default for "what generates the receipt": the printable page itself, **not** an invoice document), **View order** (owner → `/account/orders/{orderNumber}`; **tracking** (open question): stays on the order — `shippingInfo.deliveries[].parcels[].trackingData` shown by V's section on that page; guests see "Keep your order number {orderNumber}; order tracking needs an account." plus a "Create an account" link to `/register`), "Continue shopping" (`/shop/phone-plans`), and for signed-in owners "Go to order history" (`/account/orders`).
**Placement outcome unknown** (spec): when the order is **not found** but `session.pendingOrderNumber === orderNumber` the page renders `PlacementPending` (no 404): "We're checking on your order {orderNumber}. If you were charged, it will appear here shortly." with button **"Check again"** (`router.refresh()`) — a **single** retry path — and a link "Back to payment" (`/bundle/checkout?step=review`). Because the session cart still exists and the order number is reused (§3.8) a repeated payment cannot create a second order. Not found and no pending number → `notFound()`.

### 7. Cart page entry (append to M)
M's order-summary CTA becomes **"Check out"** (links to `/bundle/checkout`) for signed-in **and** anonymous buyers (D-035; replaces the prototype's "Log in to check out"); under it a text link "Sign in to use saved details" when anonymous. Appended to M's `components/bundle/OrderSummary.tsx`; M's tests that assert the old label are updated in the same commit (list them in the commit message).

### 9. Pitfalls
1. **One cart type**: never `setCustomField` on an order before `setCustomType malva-order`; the copied cart type is `malva-cart` (§5).
2. **Session expiry** and **single mount**: React 19 StrictMode double-invokes effects in development; guard session creation with a `useRef` flag so one `POST /api/checkout/session` happens per payment-step mount (grocery V used the same guard).
3. **`<div data-ctc />` must exist before the SDK call** or the widget fills the page.
4. **Totals race**: after any cart write (including M's cart routes in another tab) the total can change: §3.5 and §4 (re-authorization) cover it; never cache `/api/checkout/*` or the confirmation page.
5. **Return URL** is fixed per connector (one URL): handle `/order-confirmation/return` (§6); the locale cannot be in it.
6. **Indexing/lag**: `orders().withOrderNumber` is read-your-write consistent; do not use Order Search (D-056 lag) for confirmation.
7. **Guest cart merge**: signing in on step 1 merges the anonymous cart (E/R); the wizard must re-read the cart after returning (no stale `cartId`).
8. **de-DE**: `sdkLocale` maps `de-DE`→`de`; money `formatMoney` (`84,99 €`); the German market only accepts `DE` addresses (`COUNTRY_MISMATCH`).
9. **No secrets**: `CTP_CLIENT_SECRET`, the Sessions token and Adyen keys never appear in logs, tests, fixtures or responses; error messages carry codes only.
10. Hosted Checkout styling variables are limited to what the docs list; do not rely on class names inside the widget.

## Unit tests (scenario → test)
| Scenario (exact title from the spec) | Capability | Test (file → `it(...)` name) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Address changes the total | `checkout` | `app/api/checkout/details/route.test.ts` → "Address changes the total: shipping, tax and options are re-read from the cart after the address write" |
| Totals moved after authorization | `checkout` | `app/api/checkout/session/route.test.ts` → "Totals moved after authorization: stale expected total answers 409 and creates no session"; `components/checkout/PaymentStep.test.tsx` → "Totals moved after authorization: widget unmounts and the buyer is asked to pay the new total again" |
| Placement fails at the last moment | `checkout` | `components/checkout/PaymentStep.test.tsx` → "Placement fails at the last moment: recoverable panel, retry reuses the same order number"; `app/api/checkout/session/route.test.ts` → "Placement fails at the last moment: second session reuses the pending order number" |
| Address change moves tax | `checkout-page` | `components/checkout/DeliveryStep.test.tsx` → "Address change moves tax: summary shows the recalculated tax and shipping and withdraws a no-longer-valid method" |
| No delivery method for address | `checkout-page` | `components/checkout/DeliveryStep.test.tsx` → "No delivery method for address: states the absence, what to change, and Continue is disabled" |
| Order placed | `order-confirmation-page` | `components/checkout/OrderConfirmation.test.tsx` → "Order placed: reference, captured totals and next steps come from the order" |
| Placement outcome unknown | `order-confirmation-page` | `app/[locale]/order-confirmation/[orderNumber]/page.test.tsx` → "Placement outcome unknown: pending order number shows a single retry path and no second order exists" |
| Revisited later | `order-confirmation-page` | `app/[locale]/order-confirmation/[orderNumber]/page.test.tsx` → "Revisited later: renders from the stored order without a cart or the placing session" |

## Manual tests (owner only)
Set-up for all: owner has OA-05 done; run the app as in the Chrome set-up; a bundle with Cable 500 + a router.
- M-U-1 (needs OA-05): pay with Visa `4111 1111 4555 1142` / `03/30` / `737` signed in as a registered customer (tick "save card" if offered) → redirected to `/en-US/order-confirmation/MLV-…` with banner "Order placed.", bundle empty, header pill count 0; Merchant Center → Orders shows the order with `orderNumber` = the one shown, a Payment with a transaction `Authorization` or `Charge`, custom type `malva-order` with the three fields; Merchant Center → Recurring orders shows one recurring order per monthly line.
- M-U-2 (needs OA-05): pay with holder name `REFUSED` → hosted component shows its failure state, you stay on step 5, no order in Merchant Center, bundle intact; pay again with the good card works and creates **one** order (same number as before).
- M-U-3 (needs OA-05): signed out (guest) full purchase → confirmation shows the guest text and no "View order"; the order exists with `customerEmail` and no `customerId`.

## Excluded
- **Net terms / credit line / purchase order number / cost center / approval routing notice / approval pending notice** (specs `checkout-page`, `order-confirmation-page` "Excluded for B2C" lines and open questions on net terms): out of scope, **D-005** (B2B features) and **D-059**; payment is card through the hosted Checkout only.
- **Delivery to multiple addresses in one order** (`checkout-page` open question; `shippingMode Multiple`): out of scope, **D-005**/**D-059**; cart stays `Single`.
- **Real email confirmation / receipt PDF / invoice document**: **D-031**, **D-059**; confirmation is the page plus a print stylesheet.
- **Real serviceability, credit, billing, provisioning systems**: **D-059**; stubs from K and Q are used.

## Definition of done
- [ ] All tasks ticked, `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Every scenario row above has a passing test.
- [ ] C- and M- lines present; STATUS set to `Ready for review`; screenshots taken by Claude (C- checks); owner may comment (D-068).
- [ ] Gate recorded in `PROJECT-FINDINGS.md` (checkout mode and return URL) and `QUESTIONS.md` has any blocking entry answered.
- [ ] No secret, token or Adyen key appears in code, tests, fixtures, logs or responses; `lib/ct/checkout.ts` is the only module with a raw `fetch` to commercetools.
- [ ] A paid order always ends with `custom.type.key = malva-order` and its three fields (eager in `complete`, lazy on first confirmation view).
